title: PJM Capacity Advisory Issued for Oct. 12-13

meta.summary: PJM has issued a Capacity Advisory for Monday, Oct. 12, and Tuesday, Oct. 13, ahead of expected tight system conditions caused by relatively warm fall weather and equipment outages needed for maintenance and construction.
